verdict.rationale: IRCC's own pages point to online channels: GCKey accounts, an 'Electronic travel authorization (eTA)', application status checking, and 'Apply for a work permit' entry points. None of the cited snippets explicitly says an application can be submitted and paid for end-to-end online, and the founder-specific Start-up Visa page gives only eligibility limits, not the filing channel. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that applications (especially Start-up Visa or work permit) can be submitted online, evidence of online fee payment, and hands-on corroboration of completing a filing online.
